description: Modules 27 (event-log), 28 (webhooks-outbound), 29 (audit), 30 (feature-flags). All four are independent of FEAT-002's modules. Event-log writes/reads AuditEvent. Webhooks-outbound uses WebhookEndpoint+WebhookDelivery (schema patched in FEAT-001). Audit is a read-only admin view of AuditEvent. Feature-flags upserts the existing FeatureFlag model. FEAT-001 must be committed first (for the WebhookDelivery.status field).
steps: 1. Create apps/api/src/modules/event-log/validators.js: export logEventSchema ({ action string, targetType? string, targetId? string, metadata? record }), listEventsQuerySchema ({ action? string, resourceType? string, resourceId? string, actorId? string, from? datetime, to? datetime, limit coerce int default 50, offset coerce int default 0 }), eventStatsQuerySchema ({ from datetime, to datetime }), eventIdSchema ({ id: cuid }).

2. Create apps/api/src/modules/event-log/service.js: import prisma. Implement logEvent(orgId, actorUserId, data) — prisma.auditEvent.create({ data: { organizationId: orgId, actorUserId, action: data.action, targetType: data.targetType, targetId: data.targetId, metadata: data.metadata } }). Implement listEvents(orgId, filters) — build where: { organizationId: orgId, ...(action && { action }), ...(resourceType && { targetType: resourceType }), ...(resourceId && { targetId: resourceId }), ...(actorId && { actorUserId: actorId }), ...(from || to && { createdAt: { ...(from && { gte: new Date(from) }), ...(to && { lte: new Date(to) }) } }) }, take: limit, skip: offset, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }. Implement getEvent(id, orgId) — findFirst with 404. Implement getEventStats(orgId, { from, to }) — prisma.auditEvent.groupBy({ by:['action'], where:{ organizationId:orgId, createdAt:{ gte: new Date(from), lte: new Date(to) } }, _count:{ id:true } }).

3. Replace apps/api/src/modules/event-log/router.js entirely: router.use(requireOrg). Wire GET / (listEvents with listEventsQuerySchema), GET /stats (getEventStats with eventStatsQuerySchema), GET /:id (getEvent), POST / (logEvent 201, pass req.user.id as actorUserId). Define static paths (/stats) BEFORE /:id.

4. Create apps/api/src/modules/webhooks-outbound/validators.js: const KNOWN_EVENTS = ['invoice.created','invoice.paid','invoice.voided','payment.succeeded','payment.failed','subscription.created','subscription.canceled','credit.applied','refund.issued','alert.fired']. export createEndpointSchema ({ url: string URL refine startsWith https, events: array of enum KNOWN_EVENTS min 1, secret? string }), updateEndpointSchema ({ url? https url, events? array min 1, active? bool }), endpointIdSchema, deliveryIdSchema, listDeliveriesQuerySchema ({ endpointId? cuid, limit coerce default 20, offset coerce default 0 }).

5. Create apps/api/src/modules/webhooks-outbound/service.js: import prisma from '../../lib/prisma.js'; import { createHmac, randomBytes, createHash } from 'node:crypto'. Implement createEndpoint(orgId, data): generate secret = data.secret ?? randomBytes(32).toString('hex'); secretHash = createHash('sha256').update(secret).digest('hex'); prisma.webhookEndpoint.create({ data: { organizationId: orgId, url: data.url, secretHash, events: data.events, active: true } }); return { ...endpoint, secret } (plaintext secret shown only on create). Implement listEndpoints(orgId) — findMany. Implement getEndpoint(id, orgId) — findFirst with 404. Implement updateEndpoint(id, orgId, data) — update. Implement deleteEndpoint(id, orgId) — delete. Implement dispatchEvent(orgId, eventType, eventId, payload): find active endpoints matching eventType; for each: const body = JSON.stringify({ id: eventId, type: eventType, data: payload, createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }); const sig = createHmac('sha256', endpoint.secretHash).update(body).digest('hex'); const delivery = await prisma.webhookDelivery.create({ data: { endpointId: endpoint.id, eventType, eventId, status: 'PENDING', payload } }); try { const res = await fetch(endpoint.url, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'X-Llah-Signature': sig }, body }); await prisma.webhookDelivery.update({ where: { id: delivery.id }, data: { status: res.ok ? 'SUCCEEDED' : 'FAILED', responseStatus: res.status, deliveredAt: new Date() } }); } catch { await prisma.webhookDelivery.update({ where: { id: delivery.id }, data: { status: 'FAILED' } }); }. Implement retryDelivery(deliveryId, orgId): fetch delivery (include endpoint), verify endpoint.organizationId === orgId (403 if not), re-run send logic from dispatchEvent for that one endpoint. Implement listDeliveries(orgId, filters): findMany with where { endpoint: { organizationId: orgId }, ...(endpointId && { endpointId }) }, take/skip, orderBy createdAt desc.

6. Replace apps/api/src/modules/webhooks-outbound/router.js entirely: router.use(requireOrg). Wire GET /endpoints, POST /endpoints (201), GET /endpoints/:id, PATCH /endpoints/:id, DELETE /endpoints/:id (204), GET /deliveries, POST /deliveries/:id/retry.

7. Create apps/api/src/modules/audit/validators.js: export listAuditQuerySchema ({ limit coerce default 50, offset coerce default 0 }), exportQuerySchema ({ from? datetime, to? datetime, format enum ['json','csv'] default 'json' }), auditIdSchema ({ id: cuid }).

8. Create apps/api/src/modules/audit/service.js: import prisma. Implement listAuditLog(orgId, { limit, offset }) — prisma.auditEvent.findMany({ where:{ organizationId:orgId }, orderBy:{ createdAt:'desc' }, take:limit, skip:offset, include:{ actor:{ select:{ id:true, email:true, name:true } } } }). Implement getAuditEntry(id, orgId) — findFirst with 404. Implement exportAuditLog(orgId, { from, to, format }): const rows = await prisma.auditEvent.findMany({ where:{ organizationId:orgId, ...(from && { createdAt:{ gte: new Date(from) } }), ...(to && { createdAt:{ ...(from && { gte: new Date(from) }), lte: new Date(to) } }) }, orderBy:{ createdAt:'desc' }, include:{ actor:{ select:{ email:true } } } }); if format==='csv': build CSV header row then data rows with fields id,action,targetType,targetId,actorEmail,ipAddress,createdAt joined by commas, rows joined by newlines; return { format, data: csvString }; else return { format: 'json', data: rows }. Implement getAuditStats(orgId): two parallel groupBy queries — by targetType and by actorUserId (top 10 actors by count).

9. Replace apps/api/src/modules/audit/router.js entirely: import Router; import { requireOrg } from '../../middleware/require-org.js'; import prisma from '../../lib/prisma.js'; import * as service from './service.js'; import * as validators from './validators.js'. Add admin guard middleware after requireOrg: async (req,res,next) => { const { findByUserAndOrg } = await import('../organizations/membership-repository.js'); const m = await findByUserAndOrg(req.user.id, req.organizationId); if (!m) return res.status(403).json({ error:{ code:'FORBIDDEN', message:'Not a member' } }); const rank={OWNER:5,ADMIN:4,BILLING:3,DEVELOPER:2,ANALYST:1,VIEWER:0}; if ((rank[m.role]??-1) < 4) return res.status(403).json({ error:{ code:'FORBIDDEN', message:'Admin required' } }); next(); }. Wire GET / (listAuditLog), GET /export (exportAuditLog — respond with res.setHeader('Content-Type', format==='csv' ? 'text/csv' : 'application/json') then res.send(data)), GET /stats (getAuditStats), GET /:id (getAuditEntry). Static paths (/export, /stats) BEFORE /:id.
10. Create apps/api/src/modules/feature-flags/validators.js: export flagKeySchema ({ key: string regex /^[a-z0-9_-]+$/ }), setFlagSchema ({ enabled: boolean, description? string }).

11. Create apps/api/src/modules/feature-flags/service.js: import prisma. Implement setFlag(key, data) — prisma.featureFlag.upsert({ where:{ key }, create:{ key, enabled:data.enabled, description:data.description }, update:{ enabled:data.enabled, ...(data.description !== undefined && { description:data.description }) } }). Implement getFlag(key) — prisma.featureFlag.findUnique({ where:{ key } }) returns row or null. Implement listFlags() — prisma.featureFlag.findMany({ orderBy:{ key:'asc' } }). Implement deleteFlag(key) — prisma.featureFlag.delete({ where:{ key } }). Implement isEnabled(key) — getFlag(key).then(f => f?.enabled ?? false).

12. Replace apps/api/src/modules/feature-flags/router.js entirely: router.use(requireOrg). Wire GET / (listFlags), GET /:key (getFlag — return { data: flag ?? { key, enabled: false } }), PUT /:key (setFlag — parse body with setFlagSchema, return updated flag), DELETE /:key (deleteFlag 204).

findings: All 12 files created (validators.js, service.js, router.js for event-log, webhooks-outbound, audit, feature-flags). All 5 import checks pass (exit 0). Test suite failures are pre-existing DB connectivity issues (invalid credentials) unrelated to FEAT-003 changes.
